bullets: The image 'This Monkey' is AI-generated, the monkey has unproportionally big eyes and ears, small nose. Its skin is smooth and shiny. It looks a little too perfect to be true. The colors and lightning are oversaturated.
The image 'That Monkey' is real. The monkey has a more natural look, with realistic proportions and textures. The colors and lighting are more subdued and true to life.
